continuous_partition.artifact_contract: CI owner adds model-search-packages.txt, model-search-prerequisites.log, model-search-collection.log, model-search.log, model-search.xml and model-search-acceptance.json to .github/scripts/stage_ci_artifacts.py EXPECTED_RECORDS. continuous_partition.worker_budgets: Socket width rounds: 90 seconds each; activated-budget cases: 30 seconds each; DLG updates: 90 seconds each; SysHeteroFL: 180 seconds; selector/import cases: 15 seconds each. Existing 5+5-second owned-descendant teardown applies. Exhausted budget is failure. The 25-minute CI step budget includes provisioning and logs, not permission to relabel timeouts as skips.
continuous_partition.profile_guard_handoff: Follow acceptance.profile_guard_contract. profile_guard_contract.owner: Native-profile author, in a root-assigned follow-up after their native-profile implementation is complete and independently reviewed/accepted. Archive/runtime author supplies this contract and does not edit tests/conftest.py.
profile_guard_contract.scope: Minimal changes to tests/conftest.py _ProfileChecks partition validation and required-case selection only, plus focused guard tests. No fixture changes, MLX initialization, dependency-prerequisite relaxation or general marker-expression parser.
profile_guard_contract.deselection_predicate: For exactly runtime and not retained_model_search, permit a deselected item only if it lacks runtime OR carries retained_model_search. A runtime item without retained_model_search must never be legitimately deselected by this partition. Preserve native-profile owner's finalized native omission policy separately and exactly; do not use that policy as a blanket allowance for unrelated deselections.
profile_guard_contract.required_cases: Treat exactly runtime and not retained_model_search as a core runtime partition in sessionfinish: require the same _RUNTIME set as the existing runtime expression, and the same exact _STARTUP_CASES count/function inventory (48 cases in the immutable planning baseline). Retain the native-reviewed authoritative startup inventory unchanged. Do not select _REQUIRED DP/MPC cases for this runtime-only partition; those remain enforced by the unchanged mandatory non-runtime partition.
profile_guard_contract.expression_allowlist: Keep all existing accepted native-profile expression/invocation combinations and their enforcement. Add only the exact core runtime expression above for full tests-suite profile qualification; do not normalize/evaluate arbitrary logically equivalent expressions. Preserve the existing empty/unfiltered, runtime and not runtime modes. Explicitly reject unapproved expressions in qualified full-suite runs, including runtime and not retained_model_search and not startup_containment. Preserve prohibition of --ignore, --ignore-glob and --deselect; a -k filter that removes a required/selected core runtime case must still fail.
profile_guard_contract.dedicated_retained_invocation: Keep the exact targeted invocation of tests/integration/test_retained_model_search.py with -m retained_model_search --test-profile=mandatory. The module is stdlib/pytest-only at collection and all 19 cases have both runtime and retained_model_search markers. It is a targeted partition, not an alternative full-suite root. Permit no deselection within this dedicated targeted invocation; extra -k filtering, excluded/omitted/duplicated cases and unexpected skip/xfail/xpass must fail. Preserve mandatory import checks for opacus/kazoo/gymnasium; real ptflops provisioning/prerequisite is in the dedicated CI step. The exact independent collection/JUnit 19-case guard remains authoritative and mandatory, even if conftest also checks this targeted inventory.
profile_guard_contract.dedicated_required_case_boundary: Do not require the core startup inventory or _REQUIRED DP/MPC test nodes inside the targeted dedicated 19-case module, since those nodes are not collected there. This boundary must not disable prerequisites or unexpected-skip/xfail/xpass/exclusion enforcement, and must not relax required-case enforcement for full-suite base/non-runtime/core-runtime invocations.
unchanged_contracts: Root test-base dependency set and exact missing-Opacus prerequisite-failure probe.

profile_guard_contract.guard_verification_path: tests/test_model_search_profile_contract.py (new, authored by native-profile owner in the serialized follow-up; stdlib/pytest-only, ordinary non-runtime tests).
profile_guard_contract.test_implementation_boundary: Use narrow guard-level synthetic item/config/report tests for truth-table and required-inventory/pass/skip failures, plus bounded real pytest collect-only subprocess receipts for the four accepted partitions and negative expressions. Do not run full training in guard-unit tests or change global fixture/native initialization to make a guard test pass.

bounded_collection_receipts.assert: Accepted with unchanged _RUNTIME and exact startup inventory; all 19 retained cases excluded intentionally and no selected core runtime case lost. Preserve finalized native omission rules.
Exactly the unchanged 19 expected node IDs, both required markers, no deselection/skip. Independent CI inventory verifier must agree.

negative_receipts: Qualified full-suite collect-only using unapproved expression runtime and not retained_model_search and not startup_containment must exit nonzero with a profile violation, even if the remaining nodes otherwise pass.

Exact core runtime expression plus -k removing test_real_two_client_cpu_socket_round must exit nonzero for unexpected deselection/required omission; --deselect/--ignore/--ignore-glob exclusions remain explicitly rejected.

Guard-unit cases cover intended deselection truth table: non-runtime allowed, retained-marked allowed for exact compound partition; runtime without retained marker rejected. A required startup case spuriously marked retained still fails required/startup inventory checks.

Guard-unit cases remove a _RUNTIME node, alter one startup function count, omit a required DP/MPC node, and simulate selected-but-not-passed required nodes; each must retain a failing result. Preserve the finalized native required-case enforcement too.

Guard-unit cases inject unexpected skipped, xfailed and xpassed reports; all fail. The only accepted base DP missing-opacus report remains exactly its existing node/reason/absence predicate. The dedicated partition accepts no skips.

Dedicated retained invocation with a -k filter dropping one of 19 cases must fail; synthetic collection/JUnit artifacts missing, duplicating, skipping or failing a case must fail the independent inventory verifier.

Fresh unchanged base environment running mandatory collection still fails with exactly mandatory prerequisite failed: No module named opacus (preserve the actual existing quoted message assertion). Do not install ptflops/opacus into base to hide this negative path.
profile_guard_verification.execution_and_limits: Each new guard-unit subprocess has a 30-second deadline; each real collect-only partition subprocess has a 120-second deadline. Natural success required for positive cases and expected nonzero diagnostic for negative cases; no training or artifact scanning is performed in these guards. Then run the already-required actual base/non-runtime/core-runtime suites and all 19 retained behavioral cases on the final integrated source to prove selected required nodes actually pass. Startup inventory size/order is not changed to make a partition pass.
profile_guard_verification.native_policy_regression: Rerun the native-profile owner's accepted profile guard tests/collection checks on the guard-delta tree and compare its required case inventory/hash to the accepted base. If native profile itself is hardware-specific, preserve that owner's platform execution/receipt requirements; this archive guard change cannot claim native support through CPU collection only.
profile_guard_verification.evidence: Record final commit/tree, lock, conftest before/after SHA256, accepted-native base identity, exact commands/environments, selected/deselected node inventories, guard-test output and exit statuses. Failures remain visible and block acceptance; no implicit pass from review.
